highlights.title: Camera Tools
highlights.text: Flashback for recording and replaying Frangfurd. Turn it on under Mods in the chapter's settings.

highlights.title: Compact launcher
highlights.text: The three chapters side by side as panels. Open it from the sidebar button's right-click menu, or make the window short.

highlights.title: Storage
highlights.text: Terrain, maps, screenshots and worlds by size under Storage in the chapter's settings, each with its folder.

highlights.title: Updates in the launcher
highlights.text: Updates download in the background and install when you restart the launcher.

highlights.title: UI improvements
items: Wiki world covers as chapter art, and summer New Cliffhanger for Lichdenstein
Each chapter's slideshow keeps to its own world
Chapter settings slide in on the first frame
The resize cursor at the window's edges on Windows
Addresses in the mono field shown as typed

highlights.title: Bug fixes
items: Stop ends a download, and a game started from an open Prism
The wiki panel shows the era's page while the wiki loads

highlights.title: Tailscale
highlights.text: Join Frangfurd over Tailscale: a direct connection with a lower ping that works when playit is down. Turn it on under Server in the chapter's settings.

highlights.title: Design overhaul
highlights.text: A compact sidebar, tools in the header, a downloads section above your account, and popups that lift out of the chapter card.

highlights.title: Distant Horizons terrain for Frangfurd
highlights.text: Download the server's distant terrain under World data in the chapter's settings and see the horizon from your first join.

highlights.title: UI improvements
items: A taller title bar on macOS, with the header buttons beside the window controls
The arrow cursor everywhere, and the text cursor only where text can be selected
Java arguments open and close in place
The pack details set against the column's right edge
A short intro that draws the wordmark as the launcher opens
This page, once after each update
